evidence.note: The vendor survey provides partial support through reported productivity gains and caution. It does not establish measured substantial gains paired with categorical human verification in the same group. Unreviewed use by other respondents does not contradict this scoped claim.
The experiment measures substantial task-time savings with summer-2024 tooling. Its different period and lack of production-review evidence prevent it from settling the June-2025 joint assertion.

Available before evaluation, this study cautions against equating perceived and measured gains. Its observation window extends beyond June 16, and its distinct sample cannot disprove gains among the unspecified engineers described.

reviews.rationale: The packet supports the plausibility of substantial gains and production caution, but does not establish both in the same relevant engineers as of June 16, 2025. Low confidence does not establish categorical refusal of unchecked deployment. Other engineers' slowdowns or unchecked use do not falsify the scoped observation.
